name: Mite Kudasaimasu?
source:
Yusuke Inotani's family runs a hospital. Naturally, Yusuke was supposed to follow them into the business, but he himself was not very enthusiastic about it.

That's because the medical department is obstetrics and gynecology. "As a doctor, I wondered if I would be able to see and touch a woman's body, even though I would get nervous even when talking to a woman in a normal way."

But for Keiko, his mother and director of the hospital, it was a big deal. "Absolutely, no matter what, you must follow in our footsteps." So Keiko devised a plan. In order to make Yusuke follow the path to become an obstetrician and gynecologist, she is prepared to do ANYTHING.

(Adapted and translated from company homepage.)
translation:
猪谷雄介家经营着一家医院。按理说，雄介理应继承家业，他本人却并不热衷。

因为这家医院的科室是妇产科。“明明平时跟女性说话都会紧张，我不禁怀疑，自己当上医生后真的能够看见、触碰女性的身体吗？”

但对他的母亲、同时也是医院院长的惠子而言，这可是大事。“无论如何，你都必须继承我们的事业。”于是惠子拟订了一个计划。为了让雄介走上妇产科医生的道路，她愿意做任何事情。

（改写并翻译自公司主页。）
